source_summaries.ncfrp_v51: This dataset primarily focuses on social and demographic factors of individuals involved in fatality cases, including biological parents, caregivers, supervisors, and incident details. It lacks specific medical or physiological data relevant to SUID, postconceptional age, birth weight, maternal smoking status, gestational age at birth, infections during pregnancy, inner ear dysfunction, neurogenesis, synaptic plasticity, reactive oxygen species levels, breathing patterns, survival rates of experimental animals, lipopolysaccharide (LPS) administration, and progesterone exposure. The dataset does provide information on geographic location through state and county variables.
